context.transcript:
Hello, this is Sylvia Chen.
I recently purchased a camera from your online shop.
Unfortunately, when the camera arrived, the lens was scratched.
I want to bring it to the post office this afternoon to return it for an exchange, but I'd like to speak to someone from your company before I mail it.
You see, I'm moving to a new house next week, so the replacement will have to be shipped to my new house next week.
Please call me back so I can be sure your shipping department will send the camera to the correct address.
context.transcript_translation:
您好，我是 Sylvia Chen。
我最近在您的网上商店购买了一台相机。
不幸的是，当相机到达时，镜头被刮伤了。
我想今天下午把它带到邮局退换货，但我想先和贵公司的人谈谈。
您看，我下周要搬到新家，所以替换的设备必须寄到我下周的新家地址。
请回电给我，这样我才能确保您的运输部门会将相机寄到正确的地址。
